goals.description: Implement S1: migrate GeminiEmbeddingProvider & MemoryCortex defaults to gemini-embedding-2 (768 dims, no taskType), remap retired models & legacy v2/v3 collections to pwa_swarm_dev_cortex_v4, and tag payloads with embedModel.
goals.verificationCriteria: Incoming text-embedding-004 remaps to gemini-embedding-2, sends outputDimensionality: 768 without taskType/task_type, and falls back to gemini-embedding-001 only on 404/503.
goals.evidence: npx tsc --noEmit exited 0; cortexLearningLoop.test.ts S1 tests & embeddingFallback.test.ts passed; rg audit confirmed zero active callers of text-embedding-004 or taskType on gemini-embedding-2.

goals.description: Implement S2: multi-sport domains[] Qdrant filtering with strict appId isolation, CLV + outcome contrastive retrieval (up to 3 wins & 3 losses deduplicated by lessonId/eventId), and idempotent POST /api/cortex/ingest.
goals.verificationCriteria: Multi-sport domains=['nfl','nhl'] matches both sports under appId='duelodds'; POST /api/cortex/ingest upserts structured lessons idempotently by lessonId.
goals.evidence: cortexLearningLoop.test.ts S2 tests, qdrantStorage.test.ts (13/13), and inMemoryStorage.test.ts (9/9) passed.

goals.description: Implement S3: truthful cortexSummary telemetry (Error on embed/Qdrant failure, Empty/Success with collectionPointCount, embedModel, appliedDomains, topRawScore), run repo grep audit, tsc, and targeted Vitest.
goals.verificationCriteria: Mocked 404 from embedContent produces cortexSummary.status === 'Error' with embedError; zero hidden callers use text-embedding-004 or taskType on gemini-embedding-2; tsc and targeted Vitest pass.
goals.evidence: cortexLearningLoop.test.ts S3 tests passed (46/46 total across 7 Vitest files); npx tsc --noEmit exited 0.
